property_summary: For any ether-funded first-withdrawal-bonus call to a recipient that re-enters withdrawReward, the re-entrancy lock must make getFirstWithdrawalBonus revert; removing the lock lets the re-entrant path succeed, so the buggy contract completes the call where the reference always reverts.
change_summary: Replace `_nonReentrant` with no modifier on withdrawReward so the lock state is never set or toggled by calls to withdrawReward.
